items.title: 53279_Lee Young Oral History Interview
items.q: And then we had the group with Ted Heath and June Christie and Gary Morton and Nat.

ctx.x: Gary Morton. It was Gary Morton, June Christie, Ted Heath, and Nat Cole, you know, on that segment of it. That was when the incident happened in Birmingham, Alabama. Do you remember? When they tried to kill him on the stage at Birmingham, Alabama?
I don't remember now. I must have known then, because ...
